ingredients.name: SODIUM STARCH GLYCOLATE TYPE A POTATO

name: macitentan
indications_original: Macitentan tablets are an endothelin receptor antagonist (ERA) indicated for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH, WHO Group I)  in adults to reduce the risks of disease progression and hospitalization for PAH  ( 1.1 ).
contraindications_original: 10 mg once daily. Doses higher than 10 mg once daily have not been studied in patients with PAH and are not recommended ( 2.1 ).
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Macitentan tablets are 10 mg white colored, round shaped, biconvex, film-coated tablets, debossed with "M" on one side and "10" on other side and supplied as follows: 30 tablets white high-density polyethylene bottle (NDC 0781-8135-31) Store at 20ºC to 25ºC (68ºF to 77ºF). Excursions are permitted between 15°C and 30°C (59°F and 86°F). [See USP Controlled Room Temperature].
                     Keep out of reach of children.
